online_assessment.notes: The Kula 101 assessment is Salesforce's standardized screening tool. Questions emphasize optimization of standard algorithms rather than brute-force implementation.

specific_queries: Word Ladder problem (standard BFS) with requirement to optimize into Two-Way BFS on the fly
Mitigate combinatorial explosion through bidirectional search
Analyze and prove time complexity improvement from O(b^d) to O(b^(d/2))
technical_rounds.key_insight: Candidates are expected to recognize optimization opportunities in standard problems without being prompted. The leap from one-way to two-way BFS must be self-initiated.

specific_queries: Engineer a system using multi-map configurations
Support specific query operations: Set, Count, Delete
Maintain O(1) or O(log n) time complexities for all operations
Discuss trade-offs between hash-based and tree-based backing structures
technical_rounds.key_insight: Tests ability to design custom data structures from scratch rather than applying known patterns. Focus on operational complexity guarantees.

critical_topics: Word Ladder and graph traversal optimization
Time complexity analysis and mathematical proofs
